description.text: This Program is committed to train the senior professionals, who have solid foundation of Marxist economics, are familiar with the modern western economic theory and grasp skillfully the analyzing methods of modern economics. The Program systematically introduces fundamental economics knowledge; movement mechanism of the market economy, history and present situation of national and foreign economy, and academic development trend of the economics. Major benefits for students: The students are expected to grasp fundamental theories and analyzing method of Marxist economics, contemporary western economics, grasp analyzing method of modern economics, learn academic development tendency and the application prospect of domestic and foreign economics, understand the restructure of Chinese economy and the economical development be familiar with the economical principles, policies, laws and relegations of Party and China, grasp the basic research methods. Main Courses Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Accounting, Statistics, Econometrics, International Economics, Monetary and Banking, Public Finance, Development Economics, Marketing

duration.text: The Economics at Soochow University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 305 USD/per year ￥ 2200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3-6 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required
